cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import struct, json
data=open('trunc.db','rb').read()
PAGE=4096

def varint(buf, off):
    val=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[off+i]
        if i==8:
            val=(val<<8)|b
            return val, off+9
        val=(val<<7)|(b&0x7f)
        if not (b&0x80):
            return val, off+i+1
    raise ValueError

def parse_serial(st, body, off):
    if st==0: return None, off
    if st==1: return struct.unpack('>b', body[off:off+1])[0], off+1
    if st==2: return struct.unpack('>h', body[off:off+2])[0], off+2
    if st==3:
        v=int.from_bytes(body[off:off+3],'big',signed=True); return v, off+3
    if st==4: return struct.unpack('>i', body[off:off+4])[0], off+4
    if st==5:
        v=int.from_bytes(body[off:off+6],'big',signed=True); return v, off+6
    if st==6: return struct.unpack('>q', body[off:off+8])[0], off+8
    if st==7: return struct.unpack('>d', body[off:off+8])[0], off+8
    if st==8: return 0, off
    if st==9: return 1, off
    if st in (10,11): return None, off
    if st>=12:
        n=(st-12)//2
        b=body[off:off+n]
        if st%2==1:
            return b.decode('utf-8','replace'), off+n
        return b, off+n
    raise ValueError(st)

hdr=data[:100]
# btree header at 0
typ=data[0]
freeblock=struct.unpack('>H',data[1:3])[0]
ncells=struct.unpack('>H',data[3:5])[0]
cellstart=struct.unpack('>H',data[5:7])[0]
frag=data[7]
ptr_start=8
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',data[ptr_start+2*i:ptr_start+2*i+2])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
print('page type',typ,'cells',ncells,'cellstart',cellstart,'ptrs',ptrs)
rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    plen,o=varint(data,p)
    rowid,o=varint(data,o)
    payload=data[o:o+plen]
    hsize,po=varint(payload,0)
    serials=[]
    x=po
    while x<hsize:
        s,x=varint(payload,x)
        serials.append(s)
    body_off=hsize
    vals=[]
    for s in serials:
        v,body_off=parse_serial(s,payload,body_off)
        vals.append(v)
    print('cell@',hex(p),'rowid',rowid,'plen',plen,'hdr',hsize,'serials',serials,'vals',vals)
    # vals[0] rowid alias null, vals[1] word, vals[2] value
    rows.append((rowid,vals))
rows.sort()
out=[{"word":vals[1],"value":vals[2]} for rowid,vals in rows]
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
open('recover.json','w').write(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
EOF
